# Carmine Cuofano (@Giancarmine)

> Public-safe context for AI agents about Carmine Cuofano, an I&O Platform Engineer in
> Madrid focused on cloud, DevOps, platform engineering, and security. This repository is
> his GitHub profile; it is not a software project.

The canonical agent contract is [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md). Detailed context is in
[docs/ai/](docs/ai/README.md).

## Owner context

- [Who he is and how he works](docs/ai/context.md): role, location, expertise, working style, and communication preferences.
- [Machine-readable profile](docs/ai/profile.json): the same facts as structured JSON.
- [Glossary](docs/ai/glossary.md): terms used across the projects.

## Repositories

- [Repository catalog](docs/ai/repositories.md): every repository, public and private, grouped by status and purpose.
- [rock-paper-scissors-lizard-spock-bot](https://github.com/Giancarmine/rock-paper-scissors-lizard-spock-bot): Kotlin/Ktor Telegram bot with CI, health probes, and a Render deployment.
- [ktor_phrases](https://github.com/Giancarmine/ktor_phrases): Kotlin/Ktor emoji-and-phrase REST API with Docker and CI.
- [ansible-DRP](https://github.com/Giancarmine/ansible-DRP): Ansible playbooks that provision a fresh Ubuntu developer machine.
- `homelab` (private repository): documentation-first a virtualization platform, home automation platform, and network lab.
